title: syn-feasibility
summary: A research repository exploring synthetic data generation for feasibility assessment on MIMIC IV clinical data. It includes a Python script that builds SingleTableMetadata and trains an SDV CTGANSynthesizer to generate synthetic tabular data matching the input columns.
